articles.summary: MOUNT PLEASANT, MI / ACCESS Newswire / November 2, 2026 / Isabella Bank Corporation (the "Company" or "Isabella") (NASDAQ:ISBA), the parent company of Isabella Bank, announced today the completion of the previously announced acquisition of Grand River Commerce, Inc., the parent company of Grand River Bank (collectively "Grand River"), effective November 2, 2026. The combined company has approximately $2.7 billion in total assets, $2.0 billion in loans, and $2.3 billion in total deposits (based on financial information as of June 30, 2026). This strategic acquisition extends Isabella Bank's footprint into Kent County and the vibrant Grand Rapids market, including bringing Isabella Wealth Services to these new markets. "This strategic partnership will accelerate our growth in this vibrant Grand Rapids market," said Jerome E.
